title: Improved Sample Complexity of Robust Reinforcement Learning with KL Uncertainty Sets
abstract: arXiv:2611.33592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study distributionally robust reinforcement learning with Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence-defined uncertainty sets. The goal is to find a policy that maximizes the robust value function, defined as the worst-case value over all transition kernels in the uncertainty set. Assuming access to a generative model, we aim to understand the sample complexity of finding an $\epsilon$-optimal robust policy. The best-known sample complexity results in the literature show a non-trivial gap of $\mathcal{O}\{\max\{p_\wedge^{-1}(1-\gamma)^{-1},(1-\gamma)^{-2}\}\}$ between the upper and lower bounds, where $p_\wedge$ denotes the minimum positive transition probability of the nominal transition kernel, and $\gamma$ is the discount factor. More importantly, existing results on the lower bound only cover a limited range of the uncertainty level. In this paper, we develop tighter and complete upper and lower bounds for robust RL with K

translated_title: 基于KL不确定性集的鲁棒强化学习样本复杂度的改进
translated_abstract: 本文研究了采用Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度定义的不确定性集的分布鲁棒强化学习。目标是找到一个能够最大化鲁棒价值函数的策略，该鲁棒价值函数定义为不确定性集中所有转移核对应的最坏情况值。在假设可以使用生成模型的前提下，我们旨在理解寻找ε-最优鲁棒策略所需的样本复杂度。文献中已知的最佳样本复杂度结果表明，上界与下界之间存在大小为 $\mathcal{O}\{\max\{p_\wedge^{-1}(1-\gamma)^{-1},(1-\gamma)^{-2}\}\}$ 的非平凡差距，其中 $p_\wedge$ 表示标称转移核的最小正转移概率，$\gamma$ 为折扣因子。更重要的是，现有关于下界的结果仅覆盖了有限范围的不确定性水平。在本文中，我们为基于KL不确定性集的鲁棒强化学习开发出更紧致且完备的上下界。
tldr: 本文针对基于KL散度不确定性集的鲁棒强化学习，给出了更紧致且完备的样本复杂度上下界，填补了以往结果中的差距，并将下界覆盖范围扩展到完整的不确定性水平区间。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes tighter and complete sample complexity upper and lower bounds for robust reinforcement learning with KL uncertainty sets, closing the gap in prior results and covering the full range of uncertainty levels.
